title: Korda: One Territory, Competing Futures
summary: The Convention is meeting in Korda. Its advisory committee has begun reconciling shared facilities, service obligations and transition-cost assumptions after receiving the first fiscal materials; neither petition has been decided.
question: Can one proposed resolution address the corridor and the whole Territory together?

title: Lake Varda: Diplomacy After the Crisis
summary: Torenthia, Caldris and Valedon have scheduled the Lake Varda conference to open in Valedon during Year 14, Month 1. Civilian navigation, rescue coordination and risk reduction lead the opening agenda; responsibility for prior incidents remains unresolved.
question: What can diplomacy resolve while the public record remains contested?

title: Fiscal Equalization: The Domestic Test
summary: The Joint Committee on Fiscal Equalization has reconvened after the Executive Monitor's no-failure certification. Morantine has submitted request-aging and service-burden data for the ordinary legislative review; no amendment position has been adopted.
question: Can the Legislature improve a mechanism that is operating as written but producing widening delays?

title: Argent Ridge: Consent, Housing, and the National Trust
summary: Varek has consented to National Trust designation for its portion. Norvane has refused consent for its parcel, citing housing needs near the northern arrival corridor. The two positions remain distinct.
question: How does preservation proceed when the affected States disagree about what the land must do?
